brand.story_title: From Little Rock to the Ozarks
story: After success in Little Rock, the owners, who grew up in Northwest Arkansas, opened Bentonville in 2005.
Bella Vista, Fayetteville (2008, moved to Steamboat Dr. in 2012), Joplin (2009), Texarkana (2012), Rogers (2015), Springdale and Fort Smith (2018), and Shiloh Dr. (2026) followed.

contacts.response: Each location answers its own phone during open hours.

story.title: Bentonville
story.text: The first Northwest Arkansas Gusano's, opened in 2005 off Rainbow Curve. Kids' game area, an adults-only game room with pool tables and 25+ big screens, and an expanded patio.

story.title: Fayetteville – Steamboat Dr.
story.text: Opened near the University of Arkansas in 2008 and moved to Steamboat Dr. in 2012. Close to the Boys & Girls Club, with plenty of tables and parking for Razorback game-day crowds.

story.title: Fayetteville – Shiloh Dr.
story.text: Opened in 2026 to serve the north side of Fayetteville.

story.title: Rogers
story.text: Opened in 2015 off I-49 in Pleasant Grove. Upstairs private room (the Skybox), a kids' game room, and plenty of parking.

story.title: Bella Vista
story.text: Opened in Cunningham Corner for the Bella Vista regulars who were driving to Bentonville. Expanded twice, most recently to add a party room. Next to the golf courses.

story.title: Springdale
story.text: Opened in May 2018 for the Tontitown and Har-Ber area, close for Elm Springs and Siloam Springs too.

story.title: Fort Smith
story.text: Opened in fall 2018 on Phoenix Ave. for the River Valley. Modern dining room and a large patio.

story.title: Joplin
story.text: Opened in 2009 after a couple of Joplin locals asked for a Gusano's in their hometown. Off 7th St. in East Joplin, with big screens, plenty of parking, and a large patio.

story.title: Texarkana
story.text: Opened on Richmond Rd. in 2012 for Southwest Arkansas and East Texas. A family spot for relaxing with friends.

accessibility.title: Plan your visit
accessibility.text: Each location page lists known parking and seating details. Call ahead for anything not listed.

faq.question: What are your hours?
faq.answer: Most locations are open 11 am–10 pm Sunday through Thursday and 11 am–11 pm Friday and Saturday. Joplin closes at 10 pm every night.

faq.question: When is trivia night?
faq.answer: Each location runs its own trivia night. Choose your location to see its night.

faq.question: Can I book a room for a party?
faq.answer: Rogers has an upstairs private room called the Skybox, and Bella Vista has a party room. Call the location to book.

faq.question: How do I ask about ingredients?
faq.answer: Call your location before ordering. Staff can confirm ingredients and cross-contact.

faq.question: Are the daily specials available for takeout?
faq.answer: No. The weekly specials are dine-in only.

policies.privacy: This site has no cookies, accounts, or analytics. It remembers the location you choose in your browser's local storage so pages open to it; choose All locations to clear it. Menu filters and the gathering planner run in your browser, and nothing you type is sent anywhere. Online ordering opens on Heartland or Toast, which have their own privacy policies.
